issues.description: Card data exposure in memory and database. Full card details (number, expiry, CVV) are handled without encryption, violating PCI-DSS compliance. Card tokenization not implemented.
issues.suggestion: Use payment tokenization (Stripe, Square, Adyen) instead of handling raw card data. Store only token and last 4 digits. Never store CVV or full card number.

issues.description: Insufficient card validation. No Luhn algorithm check, doesn't validate card type, expiry parsing assumes year >= 2000 (Y2K bug if year='99' becomes 2099 not 1999). Easily accepts fake test numbers.
issues.suggestion: Use industry-standard card validation library with Luhn algorithm. Implement card type validation. Fix year parsing logic: const year = parseInt(year) + (parseInt(year) < 50 ? 2000 : 1900)

issues.description: SQL injection vulnerability risk despite parameterized queries. userId and feature parameters lack validation before database execution. No input sanitization at API boundary.
issues.suggestion: Add validation function: if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}$/.test(userId)) throw new Error('Invalid userId'). Validate all query parameters before execution.

issues.description: JSON parsing without error handling can crash application. Malformed JSON in features field causes unhandled exception and DoS attack vulnerability.
issues.suggestion: Create safeJsonParse utility: function safeJsonParse<T>(json: string, default: T): T { try { return JSON.parse(json); } catch { return default; } }

issues.description: Missing authentication and authorization checks. No verification that requesting user is authenticated or has permission to modify subscription. Anyone could upgrade any user.
issues.suggestion: Add requestingUserId parameter and verify: if (requestingUserId !== userId) throw new UnauthorizedError('Cannot modify other users subscriptions')

issues.description: Missing transaction rollback logic. If payment succeeds but subscription upgrade fails, money is charged but service not provided. Data consistency issue.
issues.suggestion: Wrap payment and subscription in database transaction: BEGIN, charge card, upgrade subscription, COMMIT. ROLLBACK if any step fails.

issues.description: Missing input validation. No type checking or validation of userId, tier, payment parameters before processing.
issues.suggestion: Add validation: if (!userId || userId.length === 0) throw Error. if (!['premium', 'enterprise'].includes(tier)) throw Error. Validate payment is object.

issues.description: Inadequate error handling. Generic error messages without context. Only console.error used for logging, no structured audit trail for payment processing.
issues.suggestion: Create structured logger with context: logger.error('Payment failed', { userId, amount, error, timestamp }). Use typed error classes for different failure modes.

issues.description: N+1 query problem. hasFeatureAccess queries database for every feature check without caching. 100 feature checks = 100 database queries.
issues.suggestion: Implement subscription cache with 5-minute TTL. Cache getUserSubscription result and check expiry/features in memory.

issues.description: Code duplication. Feature arrays hardcoded inline in multiple places. Pricing and tax constants defined in function scope.
issues.suggestion: Extract to config file: SUBSCRIPTION_CONFIG with tiers, pricing, tax rates. Import and reuse across all functions.

issues.description: Magic numbers and hardcoded values scattered throughout file. Card length 16, CVV 3-4, tax 0.08, fee 0.029, year calculation.
issues.suggestion: Create constants file: CARD_NUMBER_LENGTH, CVV_MIN, CVV_MAX, TAX_RATE, PROCESSING_FEE, SUBSCRIPTION_DURATION_YEARS

issues.description: Database error handling incomplete. Generic catch block doesn't distinguish between connection errors, duplicate key errors, or other database issues.
issues.suggestion: Check error.message for specific cases: if (error.includes('connection')) handle connection pooling issue. If 'duplicate' handle idempotency.

issues.description: Type safety issues. PaymentDetails doesn't distinguish between raw card data types and processed tokens. Features array is untyped string[].
issues.suggestion: Create branded types: CardNumber, CVV, ExpiryDate. Create FeatureId enum: 'unlimited_todos' | 'priority_support' | 'custom_themes' | 'api_access' | 'team_collaboration'

codeQuality.summary: Critical payment processing module with 4 critical security vulnerabilities (PCI-DSS violation, weak card validation, SQL injection risk, unhandled JSON parsing), 5 high-severity maintainability issues (missing auth, inadequate error handling, N+1 queries), and 4 medium-severity code quality issues. This code is not production-ready and requires significant security hardening before handling real payments.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical business logic handling payment processing. No tests for success path, failure path, or validation error handling. Payment logic must be thoroughly tested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('processPremiumPayment', () => { it('should successfully process premium subscription', async () => { const payment = { cardNumber: '4532015112830366', expiryDate: '12/25', cvv: '123', amount: 59.76 }; const result = await processPremiumPayment('user1', payment, 'premium'); expect(result).toBe(true); }); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Card validation is critical security function. All validation branches must be tested: valid cards, invalid length, invalid CVV, invalid expiry format, expired cards.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('validatePaymentDetails', () => { it('should reject card with length != 16', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ cardNumber: '123', expiryDate: '12/25', cvv: '123', amount: 50 })).toBe(false); }); it('should reject expired card', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ cardNumber: '4532015112830366', expiryDate: '01/20', cvv: '123', amount: 50 })).toBe(false); }); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Payment gateway interaction requires testing both success and failure scenarios. Must verify database query executed correctly and error handling works.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('chargeCard', () => { it('should return true on successful charge', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([]); const result = await chargeCard({ cardNumber: '4532015112830366', expiryDate: '12/25', cvv: '123', amount: 59.76 }, 59.76); expect(result).toBe(true); }); it('should return false on charge failure', async () => { db.query.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Payment failed')); const result = await chargeCard({...}, 59.76); expect(result).toBe(false); }); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Subscription state change must be tested for both premium and enterprise tiers. Features array assignment must match tier configuration.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should include enterprise features for enterprise tier', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([]); await upgradeUserSubscription('user1', 'enterprise'); const call = db.query.mock.calls[0]; const features = JSON.parse(call[1][3]); expect(features).toContain('api_access'); expect(features).toContain('team_collaboration'); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Pricing calculation is financial logic that must be exact. Tax and processing fee calculations need verification for both tiers.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('calculateSubscriptionPrice', () => { it('should calculate premium pricing with tax and fee', () => { const price = calculateSubscriptionPrice('premium'); expect(price).toBeCloseTo(10.86, 1); expect(price).toBeGreaterThan(9.99); }); it('should calculate enterprise pricing correctly', () => { const price = calculateSubscriptionPrice('enterprise'); expect(price).toBeCloseTo(54.44, 1); }); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Feature access control must be tested for valid subscriptions, expired subscriptions, missing subscriptions, and multiple features.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('hasFeatureAccess', () => { it('should grant access to valid feature', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: JSON.stringify(['unlimited_todos']), valid_until: future }]); expect(await hasFeatureAccess('user1', 'unlimited_todos')).toBe(true); }); it('should deny access to expired subscription', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: JSON.stringify(['feature']), valid_until: past }]); expect(await hasFeatureAccess('user1', 'feature')).toBe(false); }); })

untestedPaths.reasoning: Subscription retrieval must handle success (single result), no subscription (empty result), and malformed JSON error cases.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: describe('getUserSubscription', () => { it('should return Subscription object on success', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ user_id: 'user1', tier: 'premium', valid_until: now, features: '["unlimited_todos"]' }]); const sub = await getUserSubscription('user1'); expect(sub?.tier).toBe('premium'); expect(sub?.features).toContain('unlimited_todos'); }); it('should return null when no subscription', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([]); expect(await getUserSubscription('user1')).toBeNull(); }); })

untestedPaths.location: Payment validation - card number edge cases (lines 68-72)
untestedPaths.reasoning: Card number validation at length boundaries: exactly 15, exactly 16, exactly 17 digits. No Luhn algorithm check.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should accept exactly 16-digit card', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ cardNumber: '1234567890123456', ...rest })).toBe(true); }); it('should reject 15-digit card', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ cardNumber: '123456789012345', ...rest })).toBe(false); }); it('should reject 17-digit card', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ cardNumber: '12345678901234567', ...rest })).toBe(false); }); }

untestedPaths.location: Payment validation - expiry date edge cases (lines 80-91)
untestedPaths.reasoning: Expiry date parsing with year '00'-'99' needs testing. Current year 2026 means years '26'-'99' and '00'-'25' have different meanings.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should accept valid future expiry (12/26)', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ expiryDate: '12/26', ...rest })).toBe(true); }); it('should reject expired expiry (12/20)', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ expiryDate: '12/20', ...rest })).toBe(false); }); it('should handle invalid month (13/25)', () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ expiryDate: '13/25', ...rest })).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Payment amount validation must reject amounts less than calculated subscription price for both premium and enterprise tiers.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should reject payment with insufficient amount for premium', () => { const payment = { cardNumber, expiryDate, cvv, amount: 5.00 }; expect(() => processPremiumPayment('user', payment, 'premium')).toThrow('Insufficient payment amount'); }); it('should reject for enterprise too', () => { const payment = { ...above, amount: 20.00 }; expect(() => processPremiumPayment('user', payment, 'enterprise')).toThrow(); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: JSON.parse without try-catch on features field. Must test: valid JSON array, empty array, corrupted JSON, non-array values.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should handle malformed JSON in features', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: '{invalid}', valid_until: future, ...rest }]); await expect(hasFeatureAccess('user1', 'feature')).rejects.toThrow(SyntaxError); }); it('should handle empty feature array', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: '[]', valid_until: future }]); expect(await hasFeatureAccess('user1', 'any_feature')).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Subscription expiration check at exact expiry timestamp. Test: before expiry, at exact expiry time, after expiry.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should grant access before expiry', async () => { const tomorrow = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000); db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: '["feature"]', valid_until: tomorrow.toISOString() }]); expect(await hasFeatureAccess('user', 'feature')).toBe(true); }); it('should deny at exact expiry', async () => { const now = new Date(); db.query.mockResolvedValue([{ features: '["feature"]', valid_until: now.toISOString() }]); expect(await hasFeatureAccess('user', 'feature')).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Happy path where payment succeeds and subscription is upgraded. Must verify both operations occur in sequence.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should upgrade subscription after successful payment', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValue([]); await processPremiumPayment('user1', validPayment, 'premium'); expect(db.query).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2); expect(db.query).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, expect.stringContaining('payments'), ...); expect(db.query).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, expect.stringContaining('subscriptions'), ...); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Payment charge fails and returns false. Must not attempt subscription upgrade. Must handle chargeCard returning false.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it('should not upgrade subscription if charge fails', async () => { db.query.mockResolvedValueOnce(false); await processPremiumPayment('user1', payment, 'premium'); expect(db.query).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); expect(db.query).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('payments'), ...); });

testCoverage.summary: ZERO test coverage. All 7 functions are completely untested. This is critical payment processing code handling real financial transactions. Missing tests include: 42+ test cases covering payment validation (card number, CVV, expiry), payment processing (success/failure paths), pricing calculations, subscription management, feature access control, edge cases (expired subscriptions, malformed JSON, boundary conditions), and error scenarios. Test coverage priority should be CRITICAL - all major code paths must have passing tests before this code can be deployed to production.

suggestions.description: Extract payment processing and subscription management into separate service classes. Currently mixed concerns in single file make testing and reusability difficult.
suggestions.benefits: Separates concerns, enables independent testing, promotes code reuse, follows Single Responsibility Principle

suggestions.description: Extract hardcoded configuration values (pricing, tax rates, feature lists, card validation rules) into centralized config file.
suggestions.benefits: Centralized configuration management, easier to change pricing/features, eliminates code duplication, enables environment-specific configs

suggestions.description: Replace generic error handling with typed error classes for different failure scenarios. Create ValidationError, InsufficientFundsError, PaymentProcessingError classes.
suggestions.benefits: Better error handling and recovery, enables error-specific logic, improves logging and debugging, structured error details for monitoring

suggestions.description: Replace scattered JSON.parse calls with utility class for safe JSON parsing and feature validation.
suggestions.benefits: Centralized JSON handling, feature validation in one place, error handling for malformed data, prevents DoS attacks from bad JSON

suggestions.description: Change return type from boolean to Subscription to provide more information to caller. Currently returns true/false with no context.
suggestions.benefits: More informative return value, caller gets subscription details, enables better logging and tracking, simplifies subsequent feature access checks

suggestions.description: Implement caching layer for subscription data to eliminate N+1 query problem. Add TTL-based subscription cache.
suggestions.benefits: Reduces database load, improves response times, configurable cache TTL, reduces N+1 query problem from 100 queries to 1 per user

suggestions.description: Extract card expiry date validation into separate function and add Luhn algorithm check for card number.
suggestions.benefits: Better code organization, easier to test individual validation rules, enables reuse of validation functions, clearer logic flow

refactorings.summary: 7 major refactoring opportunities identified to improve code structure and maintainability. Highest impact: (1) Extract services for payment and subscription logic, (2) Centralize configuration to eliminate hardcoded values, (3) Implement typed error classes for better error handling, (4) Add caching layer to fix N+1 query problem, (5) Centralize JSON parsing/serialization. These refactorings will significantly improve testability, performance, and adherence to SOLID principles.

recommendations.description: NEVER store raw card data (number, expiry, CVV) in memory or database. Implement payment tokenization using Stripe, Square, or Adyen. Only store token and last 4 digits. This is a PCI-DSS compliance violation.

Replace custom card validation with industry-standard library that implements Luhn algorithm, validates card type, and handles expiry date parsing correctly. Current implementation is easily bypassed and contains Y2K bug.
Add validation for all function parameters (userId, tier, payment) before processing. Implement format validation for userId and reject invalid tiers. No validation currently exists.
Wrap all JSON.parse calls in try-catch blocks or use safe parsing utility to prevent DoS attacks from malformed JSON in database. Currently unhandled exceptions can crash application.
Add authentication check to verify user identity and authorization to modify their own subscription. Currently any authenticated user could upgrade any other user's subscription.

Implement 42+ test cases covering: payment validation for all card/CVV/expiry scenarios, payment processing success/failure paths, pricing calculations, subscription management, feature access control, edge cases (expired subscriptions, malformed JSON, boundary conditions). Currently 0% test coverage.
Wrap payment processing and subscription upgrade in database transaction. If payment succeeds but subscription upgrade fails, money is charged but service not provided. Use BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK.

Replace generic Error throws with typed error classes (ValidationError, InsufficientFundsError, PaymentProcessingError). Implement structured logging with context instead of console.error. Required for PCI-DSS audit trail.
Implement subscription caching with 5-minute TTL to fix N+1 query problem. Currently hasFeatureAccess queries database on every call. 100 feature checks = 100 database queries.
Extract payment processing and subscription management into separate service classes (PaymentService, SubscriptionService). Improves testability, reusability, and separation of concerns.
Extract hardcoded values to centralized config file: pricing tiers, tax rate, processing fee, feature lists, card validation rules. Enables environment-specific configuration.
Create FeatureSerializer utility to centralize JSON parsing/serialization and feature validation. Eliminates code duplication, provides consistent error handling.
Implement branded types for CardNumber, CVV, ExpiryDate, Money to prevent invalid values. Create FeatureId enum for feature strings. Improves type safety at compile time.
